description: The pairs of one week of the Antevo Tremor Index, most unusual first: the two markets, the family, the correlation of weekly returns weighted to the last few months (half-life nine weeks), z against the pair's own previous two years (positive: moving closer than usual; negative: coming apart), the direction (strengthening, weakening, or holding below two standard deviations) and the plain 26- and 52-week correlations. week is any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week wanted, default the latest; breaking_only (default true) keeps pairs at two standard deviations or more; family narrows to one family; market keeps pairs naming that market (for example Gold, S&P 500, Bitcoin); limit 1 to 200 (default 25).
name: get_tremor_pairs
title: Get tremor pairs
